data.body: Gerrit 3402 merged on main as e0e55946d12. The first main sweep after it, run 43975541557 (job 133678433834), had 1 failed, 19579 passed and 684 skipped. The one failure was the guard rejecting a CRLF `.args` line on the Windows checkout; the description's follow-up section has the root cause. Follow-up commit d178c06c3cf (Change-Id I26eac4b0) adds `eol=lf` in `.gitattributes`, a CR-byte check and a `git check-attr eol` check. File impact now includes `.gitattributes`; plan re-review is running and `make verify` is running in the worktree, which has been rebased to origin/main 9beecb409ab.
